newsitem.title: JAPAN: Department store shares up due to new Takashimaya.
newsitem.headline: Department store shares up due to new Takashimaya.

text.p: Shares in department stores were higher in the Monday afternoon session on reports of customers crowding the newly-opened Takashimaya Co Ltd branch in Tokyo's Shinjuku district, brokers said.
As of 0544 GMT, Takashimaya shares were 30 yen higher at 1,700 yen with 1.551 million shares traded. It was the twelfth most heavily traded issue.

Mitsukoshi Ltd was higher by 10 yen at 1,030 yen in turnover of 412,000. Isetan Co Ltd 8238 T was likewise 10 yen higher at 1,540 yen with 203,000 shares traded. Both have branches in the Shinjuku district.
Takashimaya opened a giant shopping mall in central Tokyo on October 4 and said 350,000 visitors showed up there that day. It had been expecting about 300,000 people.
Sales at the Takashimaya department store portion of the mall on the opening day alone were estimated at two billion yen, a Takashimaya spokesman said earlier.
